// NEGATIVE fixture — `rmSync` only where a lexer must not see it. Nothing may be reported.
import { removeDirSync, removeFileSync } from '../../../lib/compat.mjs';

// A line comment: fs.rmSync(dir, { recursive: true })
/* A block comment: fs.rmSync(dir) */
const SINGLE = 'fs.rmSync(dir)';
const DOUBLE = "fs.rmSync(dir)";
const TEMPLATE = `call removeDirSync, never fs.rmSync(dir)`;
const IN_REGEX = /\brmSync\b/;

export function mentionsRmSync(source) {
  return /\brmSync\b/.test(source);
}

export function wipe(dir, file) {
  // Near-miss in real code: `rmdirSync` is not `rmSync`.
  removeDirSync(dir);
  removeFileSync(file);
}

export { SINGLE, DOUBLE, TEMPLATE, IN_REGEX };
